post.summary: Send an OTP code on WhatsApp
post.description: Public. The platform limits run first (5 requests / 5 min, resend after 60 s, 15 min block); then the server sends a new code on WhatsApp in the `Accept-Language` language (ar default). A blocked phone or a running resend countdown answers 200 with `allowed: false` and sends nothing. A number WhatsApp cannot reach (not on WhatsApp) answers 422 `OTP_DELIVERY_FAILED` (the request still counts). A WhatsApp outage answers 503 `INTERNAL`.

allowed.description: A new code was sent on WhatsApp. `false` = blocked or resend countdown running.

otpLength.description: Number of code boxes; never hardcode it in the app.

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime of the code just sent (`otp.codeTtlSec`); 0 when no code was sent.

blockedUntil.description: Set while the phone is blocked (UTC).

post.summary: Check the typed code and get an otpToken
post.description: Public. The right code (for this phone and purpose) is used up and answers `otpToken`. Errors: 401 `OTP_INVALID` (wrong code; `details[0].message` says how many attempts are left; the 5th wrong code blocks), 401 `OTP_EXPIRED` (no code, expired or already used: request a new one), 429 `OTP_BLOCKED` (blocked for 15 min).

otpToken.description: Signed single-use proof for this phone and purpose. Send it as `otpToken` to the action of that purpose (login, register, change phone, booking confirmation, bank details).

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime of `otpToken` (`otp.proofTtlSec`); ask for a new code after it.

post.summary: Check a number before sending the OTP
post.description: 404 `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` when the number is not linked to a salon (the app offers to register one); 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` when the owner removed the member.

200.description: The number belongs to an active member

post.summary: Log in with an otpToken
post.description: `otpToken` = the single-use proof from `POST /auth/otp/verify` (purpose LOGIN) for this phone. Errors: `OTP_INVALID`, `OTP_EXPIRED` (401), `OTP_BLOCKED` (429), `MEMBER_INACTIVE` (403), `PHONE_NOT_REGISTERED` (404). The profile carries role, salon and permissions for the app to cache.

refreshToken.description: Rotates on every refresh; keep only the newest.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token
post.description: Returns a new token pair and the current profile. Reusing an old refresh token ends every session of that login (401). A removed member gets 403 `MEMBER_INACTIVE` and all sessions end.

post.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_RESPOND permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Reject a pending booking (reason code required)
post.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_RESPOND permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Mark an approved booking completed (not before its start time)

post.summary: Mark an approved booking as a no-show (not before its start time)
post.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_OPERATE permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Cancel an approved booking before its start time (reason code required)
post.description: Needs the BOOKINGS_OPERATE permission (owner always). A booking that already left the expected status answers 422 ALREADY_HANDLED; a move the state machine forbids answers 422 INVALID_TRANSITION.

post.summary: Move one person of an approved booking to another staff member
post.description: Needs BOOKINGS_OPERATE. The new staff member must pass the availability rules for that person (skills, bride qualification, working day, leave) and be free for the whole duration: 422 `STAFF_NOT_ELIGIBLE` / `SLOT_UNAVAILABLE`, 409 `SLOT_TAKEN`. Only approved bookings that have not started (422 `INVALID_TRANSITION`).

get.summary: Staff who could take over one person of an approved booking right now (BOOKINGS_OPERATE; within the booking’s branch). Advisory: reassign re-checks under the lock.

post.summary: Cancel the bookings a schedule, closure, leave or staff change would break (the ids come from the 409 SCHEDULE_CONFLICT)
post.description: Pending bookings are rejected and approved ones cancelled by the salon, with the given reason; full refunds follow. Needs BOOKINGS_RESPOND (pending) and BOOKINGS_OPERATE (approved). The answer lists each booking: `DONE` with its new status, or `FAILED` with the domain error code (e.g. already started); one failure never stops the others. Then repeat the original change. To reassign instead, use the reassign endpoint per booking.
